title: Trail-Camera Wildlife Visitor Log
dataSources: BirdNET detections (`birdnet:detection`), trail-cam detections (`trailcam:detection`), moth-trap captures (`mothtrap:capture`), bat-detector passes (`batdetector:pass`), pollinator counts (`pollinator:count`), wildlife-cam visits (`wildlifecam:visit`).
app: Backyard wildlife monitoring — BirdNET acoustic bird ID, trail cameras with object detection, camera moth traps, ultrasonic bat detectors, and pollinator counts — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:detection
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits by label _time
| stats sum(visits) as total by label
| sort - total
description: Tallies which wild animals your trail cameras record and how often, building a picture of who shares your land.
value: A visitor log turns scattered clips into an ecology of your property, revealing the deer, foxes, and badgers passing through.
implementation: Feed trail-cam detections into `index=personal`; schedule daily and rank species by visits.
visualization: Bar chart of wildlife visits by species.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which wild animals your outdoor cameras record, showing who visits your garden at night.
